power.method: 24 VAC (21-30 VAC, 50/60 Hz) or High PoE (Bosch midspan, required for heater); PoE+ (IEEE 802.3at Class 4) indoors without heater

storage.notes: Full-size SD/SDHC/SDXC card slot, max 2 TB; iSCSI recording

features: Starlight low-light: 0.0077 lx color / 0.0008 lx mono (30 IRE, F1.6)
High Dynamic Range 120 dB (100 dB per IEC 62676-5)
Intelligent Tracking with built-in Intelligent Video Analytics (IVA)
Quad streaming (two H.264 recording streams + two non-recording profiles)
Dual redundant power: 24 VAC plus High PoE / PoE+
Pan 360 deg continuous; preset speed pan 400 deg/s, tilt 300 deg/s
256 pre-positions; 24 privacy masks; image stabilization; defog
7 alarm inputs (2 supervised), 4 alarm outputs; audio line in/out
Pendant cast-aluminum housing, clear high-resolution acrylic bubble, NEMA 4X; NEMA TS 2 up to 74 C

frigate.notes: Bosch official RTSP scheme: /?inst=1 main, /?inst=2 sub (per Bosch 'RTSP usage with Bosch Video IP Devices'). Default admin user is 'service' (no factory default password — set one first). ONVIF Profile S/G (T/M on INTEOX). Not individually bench-tested.

home_assistant.notes: Generic ONVIF integration; Bosch CPP cameras are ONVIF Profile S/G compliant. Use the 'service' account.

blue_iris.notes: Bosch — use the ONVIF/RTSP (or 'Bosch') profile; default admin user is 'service'.

release_notes: Specs per official Bosch datasheet (AUTODOME_star_7000HD_Data_sheet_enUS_23680906251.pdf, 1080p edition), Pendant column. VG5-7230-EPC5 = pendant, clear bubble; VG5-7230-EPR5 = same pendant camera with IK10-rated rugged bubble (specific regions only). Power 60 W / 69 VA typical with heaters on (24 W heaters off). Operating temperature -40 to +55 C continuous with heater wired (-10 to +55 C without heater). Distinct from the 720p AUTODOME IP starlight 7000 HD (VG5-7130) already in the dataset. RTSP config uses Bosch's standard ?inst= scheme (not bench-tested).
